title: Nebular Chemistry
description: The molecular clouds are the chemistry of space: water, ammonia, methane, cyanide and soot, frozen on dust and waiting. Unlocks the Cloud Siphon, the cloud's fractions and the Strecker route to amino acids.

puzzle.goal: In a cold cloud at temperature T, a molecule holding deuterium is favoured over its ordinary twin by a zero-point energy E. Write how many times f deuterium is enriched, with Boltzmann's k.
puzzle.name: Fractionation
puzzle.ask: Find f for E = @{E} J, k = 1.381e-23 J/K and T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: The heavier molecule sits lower in its well; at low temperature the Boltzmann factor makes that tiny difference count.
